description: Reverse-ETL sink: fire one Default (default.com) API trigger per row of an upstream DataFrame, running whichever workflow is wired to that API trigger node (lead routing, scheduling, automations). Default has no upsert concept for trigger firings -- re-running on the same data re-fires the workflow.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Default API trigger fire.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_fired / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_email). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Default (workflow execution).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

trigger_id.label: Trigger ID
trigger_id.description: Default API trigger id (UUID) to fire -- from Default's list-triggers endpoint or the API trigger node in the Default workflow builder.

email_column.label: Email Column
email_column.description: Upstream column holding the lead's email. Default's fire-a-trigger endpoint requires email as a separate, required top-level field, distinct from the responses form payload.

field_mapping.label: Field Mapping
field_mapping.description: Upstream column -> Default form-field name. Populates the trigger's responses payload.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Safety cap on total rows per run.

name: Default Workflow Trigger
